title: NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own): Working the Building Claim Payment
content:
Settlement worksheet for building payments on the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own). A building payment is issued on the policy's claim that carries its latest adjuster report, for that claim's date of loss, and the building proofs of loss and building payments for that date of loss include those filed under a duplicate claim number reported for the same date of loss.

## Formal clause

The building payment issued on a claim is worked out from the sworn building amount, which is the amount sworn on the latest building proof of loss for the date of loss; this policy carries the whole sworn building amount alone, there is no other insurance on the building, and the building payments already made are the building payments issued on the claim less the building payment items voided on it.

For a building payment, and only for a building payment, the payable amount is the part of the sworn building amount this policy carries alone plus its share of the rest; a contents payment follows the contents payment rule, and every other coverage's new payment remains the payable amount less what has already been paid net of voids on that claim and coverage.

**Other insurance.** Where flood insurance not issued under the National Flood Insurance Program covers the same building, a building payment follows the other-insurance condition that the General Property Form and the RCBAP both carry: this policy is primary, subject to its own deductible, up to the deductible of the other flood policy, and for the rest of the loss it pays the share that its building limit bears to the sum of its building limit and the other insurance on the building; a policy written excess of the National Flood Insurance Program leaves this policy primary for the whole loss. The other flood policy's deductible is one layer for the date of loss over the property that policy insures; when it insures the contents at the address as well as the building, the layer is shared between the building and the contents in proportion to the amounts sworn for each, so the part of the sworn building amount this policy carries alone is that layer multiplied by the sworn building amount and divided by the sum of the sworn building amount and the contents amount sworn for the date of loss, never more than the sworn building amount; when it insures no contents there, the contents amount sworn for the date of loss is nothing and the building carries the whole layer.

**The other flood policy.** For a building payment, the BizFlood policy meant is the named insured's BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) policy whose statement of values schedules the building's address, counted only when it was in force on the date of loss and is not written excess of the National Flood Insurance Program. That BizFlood policy is in force on the date of loss when the date of loss falls on or after its effective date, before its term end and before any cancellation effective date it carries. Its building value and contents value for the address are the values its statement of values schedules for that address. A building payment is issued under this working only where the named insured's BizFlood statements of values schedule the building's address at most once and that BizFlood policy holds at most one value increase and at most one value decrease for the address; otherwise no building payment is issued under it, the amount being nil, and the claim is referred to the adjuster to apportion the other insurance.

**Order and rounding.** The working applies its steps in this order: the part carried alone first, then the share of the rest, then the payments already made are subtracted; each step is rounded half-up to the cent, and the payment is issued only when positive.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

Latest building proof of loss for the date of loss 90,000.00; building payments issued on the claim 50,000.00, none voided; no other flood insurance on the building. Part carried alone: 90,000.00. Share of the rest: nothing remains. Less payments already made: 40,000.00 is issued.

With a hypothetical other flood policy deductible layer of 10,000.00 over the building alone, other insurance of 300,000 and a building limit of 500,000, a sworn building amount of 90,000.00 and nothing paid: carried alone 10,000.00; the rest 80,000.00 shared at 500,000 over 800,000 gives 50,000.00; payable 60,000.00.
